name: Landscape Maintenance Operations
audience: small commercial landscaping and recurring property-maintenance companies
topic: visit exceptions, enhancement approvals, and seasonal service changes

products.name: Property Visit Exception
products.product: A focused landscape maintenance visit exception tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small commercial landscaping and recurring property-maintenance companies
products.problem: Rain, locked areas, parked vehicles, irrigation leaks, debris, special events, and crew shortages alter recurring visits, but the contract consequence and recovery work can disappear in route notes.
products.valueProposition: Turns landscape maintenance visit exception tracking into a visible operating queue so every incomplete landscape visit has quantified skipped work, evidence, contract treatment, customer communication, and a recovery decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets landscape service exception, lawn route completion tracker, landscaping missed service, and property maintenance visit log searches.

products.name: Enhancement Approval Desk
products.product: A focused landscape enhancement proposal approval tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small commercial landscaping and recurring property-maintenance companies
products.problem: Crew observations and customer requests for mulch, pruning, replacements, drainage, irrigation, or seasonal color stall before estimating because evidence and ownership do not travel together.
products.valueProposition: Turns landscape enhancement proposal approval tracking into a visible operating queue so every qualified enhancement request reaches a priced customer decision with field context, scope assumptions, and a scheduled or closed next action.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets landscape enhancement proposal, landscaping upsell tracker, property improvement estimate, and landscape proposal follow up searches.

products.name: Seasonal Service Change Register
products.product: A focused seasonal landscape service change tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small commercial landscaping and recurring property-maintenance companies
products.problem: Frequency, task mix, irrigation checks, cleanup, snow or storm coverage, and property priorities change by season, yet crews may keep using an outdated recurring-service plan.
products.valueProposition: Turns seasonal landscape service change tracking into a visible operating queue so every seasonal contract change has an effective date, customer approval, route impact, crew acknowledgment, and verified first execution.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets seasonal landscaping schedule, landscape contract change, lawn service frequency tracker, and property maintenance service plan searches.
